name: lms-root
description: FullStack Pro LMS - Root manager to run client and server together

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "client,server" -c "cyan.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix server"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "client,server" -c "cyan.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run start --prefix client" "npm run start --prefix server"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
